boundaries: The role is tracking responsibility for unassigned concerns.
semantic_owner, composition_owner, and lifecycle_owner stay unassigned-tracking.
This record does not establish semantic, composition, or lifecycle ownership.
BioETL Team is a documented role, not a resolvable GitHub assignee.
Per-row *_tracking_responsibility strings in the frozen map remain trace pointers, not this role and not ownership.
.github/CODEOWNERS default @SatoryKono remains review ownership and is counted separately.

metrics.owner_coverage_definition: Rows whose semantic, composition, and lifecycle owners are all values other than unassigned-tracking. Tracking responsibility does not increment this numerator.
metrics.tracking_responsibility_coverage_definit: Rows whose three unassigned concerns are covered by the BioETL Team tracking role in this decision. This is not owner coverage.
metrics.trace_pointer_definition: Frozen-map rows with non-empty semantic, composition, and lifecycle trace pointers.
